name: An empty worker wake is recorded and shown
aliases: worker woke with nothing to do
summary: A worker wait wakes when the fingerprint of its move rows changes. An EMPTY wake is that change with no row that is the caller's move (an integrated-but-open task whose review state moved is the .390 case). One shared rule compares the caller's full work --mine rows with the rows it last saw and names the changed field class (new-comment, review-state, assignment, delivery, review-items, status, guidance, edit); a wake is empty only when no changed row is the caller's move. The read already made by the CLI endpoint action and by GET /v1/agents/me/wait records it once per (actor, task, fingerprint) in <project>/.wait-wakes/: a bounded append-only per-lane JSONL (4096 bytes / 64 entries / 24 h, oldest dropped, atomic rewrite under a lock, symlinks refused). It is best effort: an error is an answer warning and never fails or changes a wait, and nothing is written to the tracker. work lanes adds empty_wakes_24h and the newest task, trigger and time; the coordinator wait gains an empty-wake trigger at three different fingerprints in 24 hours. Worker move sets and fingerprints are unchanged; the new trigger group is only in the coordinator fingerprint when it has a row.
